main.remarks: A recipient may be identified by object identifier alone or by an explicit certificate that provides thumbprint and public-key matching material.

constructor.name: ConstructorObject
constructor.summary: Create a recipient identified only by object identifier.
constructor.returns: A recipient identified by object identifier.

constructor.name: ConstructorCertificate
constructor.summary: Create a recipient from a certificate and optional object identifier.
constructor.param: Optional object identifier associated with the certificate.
constructor.returns: A recipient identified by certificate material.

property.name: ObjectId
property.summary: Optional object identifier for the recipient.

property.name: Thumbprint
property.summary: Optional thumbprint used to match the recipient certificate.

property.name: PublicKeyHash
property.summary: Optional SHA-256 hash of the recipient public key used as a match hint.

property.name: Certificate
property.summary: Optional direct certificate reference available while building the security context.
